capabilities: look up Quran and hadith by reference ID
insert fetched text and translation into the note
customize replacement templates with JSON notation
support Quran single verses and ranges
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to insert Quran or hadith quotations from a reference ID without looking up and copying the text manually.

relations.evidence: lookup and insert Quran and Hadith text and translation using the Hadith Unlocked API

summary: Plugin that uses a selected reference ID to fetch and insert Quran verses or hadith text and translations from the Hadith Unlocked API.
